subject.title: feat: apply messages.responsePrefix to message tool outbound sends

question: Should agent-originated `message(action=send)` deliveries receive selected provider/model/full-model/thinking context for `messages.responsePrefix` templates, or should message-tool sends intentionally remain static/identity-only?
rationale: Current main deliberately skips unresolved dynamic prefixes because the message-tool send path does not perform model selection, so completing the request requires choosing a runtime contract and owner boundary.

options.title: Thread run context into sends
options.body: Apply dynamic responsePrefix templates for agent-originated message-tool sends using the actual selected provider, model, full model ref, and thinking level while keeping unresolved-placeholder skipping for sends without run context.

options.title: Document static and identity only
options.body: Keep current behavior and document that message-tool sends support only static and identity prefixes unless a future owner designs run-context plumbing.

options.title: Split a narrower design tracker
options.body: Replace or narrow this issue to selected-model prefix parity now that static and identity prefixing has landed.

recommendation.title: Thread run context into sends
recommendation.body: Apply dynamic responsePrefix templates for agent-originated message-tool sends using the actual selected provider, model, full model ref, and thinking level while keeping unresolved-placeholder skipping for sends without run context.

likelyOwner.reason: The remaining choice is a runtime/product contract decision, and recent history routes shared reply-prefix context and per-agent prefix ownership through this contributor.
